title: Temple of Poseidon
summary: The Temple of Poseidon is the only entrance to Atlantis, the sunken city. It is one of the six temples built by the Atlanteans, and the only one to rest upon the surface, serving as a gateway to the city in ancient times. Its ruins are located somewhere along the Greek coast of the Aegean Sea.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
The Huntik team found the ruins of the Temple on their quest for the [[Amulet of Will]], and later battled [[Rassimov]] and his [[Suits]] here. Upon finding the hidden entrance, Lok led the team through it using the pages of [[Eathon Lambert's journal]] as a key, escaping Rassimov's men and his invulnerable [[Anubian]] Titan. {{source|The Unseen Guide}}

Rassimov later found his own way through the entrance with his men, using torn pages from the journal given to him by [[the Professor]]. {{Source|Coming of Age}}{{Clear}}
